note: Elite variants of existing robots. Marked with a code-drawn ring and overhead label only; robot art pixels are never tinted or altered. An encounter row opts in with "affix": "<ID>".

SHIELDED.title: SHIELDED
SHIELDED.tip: SHIELDED: the cyan barrier soaks hits and recharges after 4.5 s without damage; burst it down.

OVERCHARGED.title: OVERCHARGED
OVERCHARGED.tip: OVERCHARGED: hits harder and attacks sooner; break line of sight between its shots.

VOLATILE.title: VOLATILE
VOLATILE.tip: VOLATILE: bursts when destroyed; leave the yellow circle. The blast ignores cover.

BROODING.title: BROODING
BROODING.tip: BROODING: destroying it hatches two plain drones; the green rings mark their 0.6 s hatch before they attack.

BEACON.title: BEACON
BEACON.tip: BEACON: violet links reduce nearby robots' incoming damage by 25%; destroy the beacon to release them.
